api:
<ParallelCoordinates data={flowers} axes={axes} name={|f: &Flower| f.id.as_ref()} value={|f: &Flower, axis: usize| f.sizes[axis]} group={|f: &Flower| f.species} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas above: one row per linerequired
axesVec<SharedString>: one vertical axis eachrequired
nameFn(&T) -> &str: the line's label in the tooltiprequired
valueFn(&T, usize) -> f64required
groupFn(&T) -> &str: colour and legend entryone colour per row
line_opacityf320.6
line_widthf321.5
legendLegendshown with a group, hidden without
tooltip, class

Each axis is scaled from its own minimum to its maximum, both written at its ends. Hover near a line to highlight it and read all its values. A missing value breaks the line. It takes the same axes / value data as <Spider>.

Zoom: hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and scroll, or pinch, to zoom about the pointer. Drag a rectangle to zoom into it, Shift and drag to pan, and double-click to reset.

examples.title: Three species
examples.description: Each flower is one line across four measures, coloured by species; hover a line to read it.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn iris() {
    let data = use_signal(flowers());
    rsx! { <ParallelCoordinates data={data} axes={axes()} name={|f: &Flower| f.id.as_ref()} value={|f: &Flower, axis: usize| f.sizes[axis]} group={|f: &Flower| f.species} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Twelve flowers
examples.description: Without a group every line has its own colour.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn ungrouped() {
    let data = use_signal(flowers().into_iter().take(12).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    rsx! { <ParallelCoordinates data={data} axes={axes()} name={|f: &Flower| f.id.as_ref()} value={|f: &Flower, axis: usize| f.sizes[axis]} line_width={2.} line_opacity={0.9} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: One species
examples.description: Only Setosa, so every line shares a colour.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn setosa() {
    let data = use_signal(
        flowers()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|flower| flower.species == "Setosa")
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <ParallelCoordinates data={data} axes={axes()} name={|f: &Flower| f.id.as_ref()} value={|f: &Flower, axis: usize| f.sizes[axis]} group={|f: &Flower| f.species} class="h-72" /> }
}
